lesson.subtitle: Lesson 1 -- The Lawyer Inside the Business
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Amanda Merlini | Lesson 1 -- The Lawyer Inside the Business

vocab.title: Match each expression to its meaning
defs: a legal dispute that a court decides
giving a legal opinion so that the business can decide
the team of lawyers inside a company
the industry that turns farming into a business
a lawyer who works for one company instead of a law firm
to take care of a matter from the beginning to the end
to write the first version of a contract or a document
following the law, the rules and the internal policies

items.situation: Anton asks: "What is your team responsible for?"
tips: My team is responsible for contracts, litigation and advisory work.

items.situation: He asks: "Who do you report to?"
tips: I report to the managing director of the operation.

items.situation: He asks: "What does advisory work mean, in one sentence?"
tips: It is the work where I give an opinion so that the business can decide.
Say it without Latin. He is an economist.

items.situation: A colleague asks: "Who writes our contracts?"
tips: We draft them here, and I review every contract before we sign it.
Use who or that to make it one sentence, not two.

items.situation: He asks: "What is not your responsibility?"
tips: Employment law is not in my scope: an outside firm takes care of it.
Saying what is outside your scope is part of the answer.

items.situation: He asks: "And who do you work with every day?"
tips: I work closely with the commercial team and with the plant managers.

listenings.text: Hi Amanda, it's Irina from the group office. Quick one about next week. Anton Larin arrives on Monday as our new Group Operations Director for South America, and he wants to meet the head of every department before the end of the week. He has one afternoon for the whole site, so each manager gets three minutes. Three minutes, no slides. Please tell him three things: which matters your team handles, who you work with inside the company, and one thing that is not your responsibility. And send me two lines about that by Thursday at noon, so that I can put them in his file. One more thing. He is a finance person, not a lawyer, so please avoid the Latin. Thank you, Amanda. Talk to you on Thursday.

Hello, everyone. My name is Anton Larin and I start on Monday as Group Operations Director for South America. I am recording this because I cannot meet all of you in person this week. A short introduction. I am an economist, not a lawyer, and for the last six years I looked after the grain business in Eastern Europe, so the South American operation is completely new for me. In my first month I want to understand how each department really works, and I mean the daily work, not the organisation chart. So when we meet, please tell me three things: what your team handles every week, who depends on you, and one problem that comes back again and again. Three minutes each is enough. Thank you, and see you next week.

extra_audio.text: Say your role and the company you work for. Then name the three kinds of work your team handles. Then say who you work with inside the company. Then say who you report to. And finally, say one thing that is not your responsibility, and who takes care of it.
